== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born about 1710. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1406|Michael Glasgow]] and [[Baird-5776|Catharine Baird]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1406]] is assessed at 97% (proved). Elizabeth’s 12 November 1710 Irvine entry names Michael Glasgow and maternal surname Baird, matching Agnes 1706 and Janet 1715. The omitted maternal forename leaves a little more identity uncertainty than the fully named couple.

Adult Michael/Baird household; no claim that the transcript explicitly names Kathrine here.

Next useful test: Compare original p15 with 1706 and 1715 to test omitted maternal forename and any witnesses.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3572925&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Elizabeth Glasgow, 12 Nov 1710, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3572925].
